backend/main.mo: Defines the backend actor with all core domain types for users, providers, clients, jobs, documents, and platform configuration.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking a back‑office admin UI feature to affected files, components, and test ID REQ-110.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries of many frontend source files describing their roles and behaviors.
frontend/index.css: Defines Tailwind base variables and theming tokens for light and dark modes with global styling rules.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the frontend app including PWA metadata, icons, and script bootstrap.
frontend/public/.well-known/ic-domains: Lists the domain used for Internet Computer domain verification.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest defining app name, icons, theme colors, categories, and metadata.
frontend/public/offline.html: Standalone offline fallback page with simple styling and a retry button.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker handling install, activation, cache versioning, offline fallback, and static asset caching with IC call exclusions.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app managing authentication, routing state, onboarding, and service worker registration.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Layout wrapper rendering header, footer, content, and support drawer with optional navigation props.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Implements a login/logout button using Internet Identity, handling authentication state, errors, and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/auth/PhoneOtpVer: Handles phone-based OTP verification, including sending codes, validating input, showing errors, and notifying when verification succeeds.
frontend/src/components/auth/RoleOnboard: Guides new users through selecting a role and creating minimal initial profiles, with validation and saving via the backend actor.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with copyright text, a support drawer trigger, and a Caffeine.ai attribution link with dynamic hostname tracking.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Provides a responsive header with role‑based navigation, logo display, login button, and a mobile slide‑out menu.
frontend/src/components/landing/DemoVide: Displays a placeholder section for an upcoming demo video explaining how the app works.
frontend/src/components/landing/Platform: Shows animated platform statistics for clients and providers, using backend data with minimum thresholds and count-up animations.
frontend/src/components/landing/RoleQuic: Lets users quickly choose a role, triggering login if needed or navigating to role-specific pages when authenticated.
frontend/src/components/landing/Testimon: Displays a testimonials section with hardcoded reviews, star ratings, and provider avatars using cards and a grid layout.
frontend/src/components/landing/useLandi: Empty file with no implemented logic.
frontend/src/components/location/Locatio: Provides inputs for address and coordinates plus a button to auto-fill location using browser geolocation.
frontend/src/components/messaging/Conver: Implements a messaging UI with message list, sending simulation, refresh button, and input area for composing messages.
frontend/src/components/notifications/En: Shows a temporary alert indicating whether a provider is engaged, with auto-hide and manual dismiss support.
frontend/src/components/payments/MpesaUn: Modal dialog handling M-Pesa payment flow to unlock provider contact details, including phone input, processing, and success states.
frontend/src/components/providers/Featur: Renders provider avatars with fallback initials and size options, handling image load errors.
Displays a grid of demo featured providers with avatars, ratings, location info, and verification badges.
frontend/src/components/providers/Provid: Generic provider avatar component showing a profile image or initials with configurable sizing.
Displays a provider card with avatar, verification and engagement badges, location, rate, category, and rating summary.
Shows a dialog with a quick preview of a provider including avatar, verification, availability, ratings, and action buttons.
frontend/src/components/providers/Unlock: Renders a card explaining and processing the connection fee required to unlock a provider’s contact details.
frontend/src/components/pwa/InstallPromp: Banner prompting users to install the PWA with special handling for iOS instructions.
frontend/src/components/pwa/UpdateAvaila: Displays a banner when a service worker update is available, allowing refresh or dismissal.
frontend/src/components/ratings/StarRati: Displays star ratings with support for full, half, and empty stars plus rating text.
Five-star interactive rating input component with optional readonly mode.
frontend/src/components/support/SupportD: Drawer providing customer support contact details via phone and email.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages a backend actor based on user identity and refreshes dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useCountUpOnVisible.t: A hook that animates a count-up value when its element becomes visible using IntersectionObserver and easing.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, handling login, stored identity loading, and status tracking via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/usePWAInstallPrompt.t: Detects PWA installability, manages beforeinstallprompt events, and exposes a method to trigger installation.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Wraps backend actor calls in React Query hooks for profiles, providers, stats, config, OTP, and updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useServiceWorkerUpdat: Monitors service worker updates and exposes a trigger to activate the new worker and reload the page.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light/dark theme variables and custom landing background styles.
frontend/src/lib/categories.ts: Defines service categories with IDs, labels, business types, and icons for use in filtering and UI.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point initializing React, QueryClient, and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/pages/auth/ClientAccessPage: Client login/signup page using Internet Identity with phone OTP verification flow.
frontend/src/pages/auth/ProviderAccessPa: Provider login/signup page with Internet Identity authentication and phone OTP verification.
frontend/src/pages/backoffice/ProviderDa: Admin-only panel for deleting and seeding provider datasets with success/error feedback.
frontend/src/pages/backoffice/Verificati: Admin review page for provider verification, currently placeholder, including dataset management tools.
frontend/src/pages/client/CategoriesPage: Displays searchable service categories and navigation to provider results, including an 'All Providers' option.
frontend/src/pages/client/ClientProfileP: Client profile page that displays account info and lets clients set or update a pinned location using a map picker.
frontend/src/pages/client/MapViewPage.ts: Placeholder map view page showing a back button and an alert that map functionality is not yet available.
frontend/src/pages/client/MyJobsPage.tsx: Page for managing client jobs, currently showing a placeholder message and link to browse services.
frontend/src/pages/client/ProviderDetail: Provider detail page with live polling, engagement status detection, rating calculation, and navigation to results or unlocking actions.
frontend/src/pages/client/ProviderResult: Displays provider search results with polling previews, engagement status detection, and navigation to map or detail views.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Landing page combining hero content, role-based navigation, stats, featured providers, testimonials, and feature highlights.
frontend/src/pages/provider/ProviderProf: Provider profile management page supporting location updates, engagement toggling, and editable profile fields.
frontend/src/pages/provider/Verification: Shows provider verification status and a placeholder for future document upload features.
frontend/src/utils/engagementTime.ts: Utility functions to compute and format remaining engagement time and detect expiration.
frontend/src/utils/fees.ts: Provides helpers to compute a 10% connection fee from a bigint rate and format KES amounts for display.
Stores, retrieves, validates, and clears a pending user role in sessionStorage.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading URL parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and managing hash/query parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS config extending theme colors, fonts, layout, animations, and enabling plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing app vision, architecture notes, known issues, and existing feature records.
